meta.name: Medusa
meta.description:
Somebody wants to kill CEO Bárbara Hidalgo. Can she find the culprit as her family schemes ruthlessly for control of their Colombian business empire?

Complete series. On your server: S1 12/12 | S2 12/12

videos.title: Lady Death
videos.overview: Detective Danger Carmelo investigates the disappearance of Medusa Corporation's new CEO Bárbara Hidalgo after a suspicious explosion on her yacht.

videos.title: The Awakening
videos.overview: Attempting to regain both her fractured memories and control of Medusa, Bárbara pieces together the family's tangled struggle for supremacy at the firm.

videos.title: Past Selves
videos.overview: Danger reflects on the vendetta that cost him his police career while Bárbara recalls her unconventional marriage and the identity of her lover.

videos.title: Jackals
videos.overview: As Bárbara and Danger become intimate, he uncovers a plot between Camilo and Cristian while she reveals to the family her suspicions about the blast.

videos.title: Chaos Unleashed
videos.overview: The family discuss how Bárbara's outburst affects their schemes, while Damián and Esteban try to sabotage Danger's investigation into the explosion.

videos.title: Flight of the Harpies
videos.overview: Bárbara plots her way back to power through an unlikely alliance. Defying orders to drop the case, Danger digs even deeper into Bárbara's world.

videos.title: Danger
videos.overview: A tragic incident blows Esteban's private life wide open and gives Danger a fresh angle on the case. Meanwhile, Bárbara's ex demands her attention.

videos.title: Mother's Web
videos.overview: Backed by her community, Bárbara's old flame shames her in public. Damián hopes for a peaceful birthday but tempers flare within the family.

videos.title: Tainted Seed
videos.overview: The scheming Hidalgos consider removing an under-fire Bárbara from Medusa. Can she regain the trust of her former lover to rescue her reputation?

videos.title: One Down
videos.overview: Painful family flashbacks set Bárbara's head spinning, while Damián wants her out of Colombia. Unperturbed, Danger senses a breakthrough in the case.

videos.title: Predator
videos.overview: With Esteban at arm's length, Danger reconnects with Bárbara. The Medusa boardroom is a snake pit once more, as Damián fights for his position.

videos.title: Medusa
videos.overview: Bárbara shakes things up at Medusa, but when she thinks she's safe to enjoy Barranquilla Carnival, an unlikely threat throws her back into danger.

videos.title: The Flame That Never Went Out
videos.overview: New threats and personal vendettas stoke tensions within the Hidalgo family as Danger's latest investigation reveals a conspiracy to ruin Medusa.

videos.title: Burn the Witch
videos.overview: As Bárbara tightens her grip on Medusa, the Hidalgo family bears the weight of her ruthless choices while Danger investigates who could be after her.

videos.title: Hidalgo vs. Hidalgo
videos.overview: While the Hidalgo family splinters into factions, Danger's investigation turns to Bárbara's past as she prepares for a legal confrontation with Damián.

videos.title: Cursed Mushroom
videos.overview: Bárbara's ambition pushes her loved ones away as others plan her ruin. Amid a string of deadly attacks, Danger confronts his partner's shady past.

videos.title: Magic Root
videos.overview: When allegations against Eternals jeopardize Medusa's future, Bárbara scrambles to contain the fallout while being pursued by a relentless threat.

videos.title: The Hand That Feeds
videos.overview: Medusa's grip on Bárbara deepens while she faces off against Damián. Danger confronts difficult truths as the killer strikes with chilling precision.

videos.title: The Flowers of Passion
videos.overview: Danger closes in on answers as long-buried truths about the killer finally begin to surface. Bárbara must face an unexpected and bold new competitor.

videos.title: Junior
videos.overview: While Damián's past choices create new dilemmas and dangers, Bárbara makes moves to protect those closest to her and regain public trust in Medusa.

videos.title: Poisonous Brews
videos.overview: Danger's credibility comes under fire as Bárbara's ego disrupts her relationships. The Hidalgo family grapples with Damián's latest power play.

videos.title: In a Fix
videos.overview: With Danger unavailable and her life in turmoil, Bárbara finally reaches a breaking point. Can she hold Medusa together without losing herself?

videos.title: Bårbara vs. Medusa
videos.overview:
Everything falls into place for Bårbara as she takes back control of

her life. Meanwhile, Danger's relentless investigation leads to a

damning clue.

videos.title: Brito
videos.overview:
Secrets and rival agendas collide as the battle for Medusa reaches

a climax, forcing Bårbara, Danger and the Hidalgo family to face

the consequences.
